meta.name: Consortium Servo Krake Innerer Ring
meta.description: Water fountain effect, not a luminaire. The supplied local record describes five upright tilting arms on a shared open pentagonal frame, each carrying one water nozzle and no light emitter. Exact-model product photographs, manufacturer dimensions, weight and DMX channel tables were not found. Geometry remains an unverified approximation based on the local imported record; centimetre units are assumed. Overall dimensions are retained from the import, not manufacturer verified. Independent nozzle/servo control is unknown; zero light cells does not mean zero servo DMX channels.

photo_pass.identity: No supplied photos; no exact-model source found after exact-name, ServoKrake, Servo-Krake, manual, discontinued and Consortium Eventtechnik/Wien searches. Related Servo Krake 300 and generic Servokrake sources rejected as different/unidentified products.
photo_pass.corrections: Removed invented lenses, light sources and per-arm lighting cells. Replaced round wash heads and yokes with upright bar arms directly on the carrier, following the supplied description.
photo_pass.geometry_basis: facts.json: five ARM nodes; ARM mesh approximately 9.3 x 34.9 x 7.1 unspecified units; assuming centimetres gives 0.093 x 0.349 x 0.071 m. This scale, overall bbox, frame shape, pivot height and nozzle geometry are not photo verified.
photo_pass.control_basis: Local record mentions Mode 1, Normal Mode, Servo Ref and Tilt, but provides no channel-count table or verified independent control mapping. No luminous emitters; servo DMX cell count unknown.
photo_pass.limitations: Luma has no fountain/nozzle emitter type or explicit pentagonal open-frame carrier. Empty non-emitting face root is intentional; ring carrier is an approximation.

root.note: No optical face: water nozzle, not a light. Five physical nozzles are described in the imported record, one per array arm; nozzle geometry and servo control remain unverified.
